thread:
Samira Khan: hey — quick q on channel norms for my first week. where should i put general onboarding q's vs. technical/setup stuff vs. 1:1 stuff? also how do i stop or opt-in to the onboarding bot pings?

Luke Park: welcome! :wave: short rules that help: post onboarding questions in #new-hires so everyone can see answers, use threads for follow-ups.

Luke Park: technical/setup stuff goes in #help (or #eng if infra-specific) and include a short snippet or the exact error. DMs for private/confidential stuff or salary/HR stuff.

Emma R.: for infra/hardware issues ping @IT Support or open a ticket, but a quick note in #new-hires like "blocked on laptop" helps so someone can escalate. For logs, paste a minimal snippet in a code block, e.g.:

Emma R.: ```
Error: gRPC timeout connecting to internal-gateway
Request ID: abc123
Steps I tried: restarted laptop, reauth'd CLI
```

Maria Gomez: onboarding-bot is opt-in. To subscribe to daily tips in #new-hires do `/invite @Onboarding Bot` in that channel or click the channel name -> Integrations -> Add apps -> Onboarding Bot. If you want fewer pings, message the bot `settings mute` or `unsubscribe` in a DM.

Onboarding Bot: Hi Samira! :star: Welcome to Redwood Inference. I've added you to the Day-1 checklist in #new-hires. Type `help` for commands or `unsubscribe` to stop messages.

IT Support: if you need hardware access or VPN, please DM us and include your preferred OS + whether you need admin rights. We can also schedule a quick remote session.

Samira Khan: thanks — super helpful. one small question: if i have a question about API usage that's not urgent, post in #eng or #product?

Luke Park: post in #eng if it's implementation/SDK related, #product for product/UX questions. If unsure, #new-hires is fine and we'll redirect.

Samira Khan: perfect — thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: small etiquette tip — threads > new messages for follow-ups, add context, and react with :eyes: or :thumbsup: when resolved so threads don't linger.

Samira Khan: noted, will do. :)
